Method of Attack: Command injection vulnerability in KDE KDesktopFile class via specially crafted .desktop and .directory files that unsafely evaluate environment variables and shell expansions, allowing code execution when opening folders or extracting archives containing malicious files.
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions using vulnerable KDE versions
Attack Vector: Downloading and extracting an archive containing malicious .desktop or .directory files, then opening the folder in KDE file manager (Dolphin) or desktop.
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .desktop or .directory files with commands embedded in the Icon field
test.zip archive containing a subfolder with a .directory file executing commands
test.sh script downloaded and executed to launch Kcalc
